item.text: The ACT Integrity Commission investigated consultancy contracts awarded by the Canberra Institute of Technology, with this report addressing disclosure to its board and responsible minister.
item.support: in relation to the performance of their duties of disclosure to the CIT Board

item.text: It examined whether the chief executive and board chair disclosed important information about the contracts.
item.support: This Report is limited to findings regarding the conduct of the CIT’s Chief Executive Officer

item.text: The Commission found that the chief executive deliberately concealed information from the board and engaged in serious corrupt conduct.
item.support: It follows that Ms Cover was guilty of serious corrupt conduct within s 10

item.text: It found that the board chair seriously failed to exercise care and diligence, but could not make a corruption finding because intentional or reckless conduct was not established.
